$comment: Single source of truth for every tool the site links to. Outbound links go through /go/<id>, generated into public/_redirects by scripts/build-redirects.mjs. To monetise a tool, fill in affiliateUrl here and nothing else changes anywhere.

tools.name: Lovable
tools.description: Build full-stack web apps from plain-English prompts. Best for SaaS MVPs with real backend needs.
tools.bestFor: SaaS MVPs that need auth and a database

tools.name: Bolt.new
tools.description: Instant web apps in the browser, no account needed to start. Best for quick prototypes.
tools.bestFor: A working prototype in one sitting
tools.notFor: Anything that needs a real backend

tools.name: Cursor
tools.description: AI-first code editor. Understands your codebase context. Best for developers going faster.

tools.name: v0 by Vercel
tools.description: Generate React UI components from descriptions. Best for frontend prototyping and design-to-code.
tools.bestFor: Turning a design idea into React components

tools.name: Framer
tools.description: Build and publish responsive websites visually. Best for marketing sites and landing pages.
tools.bestFor: Marketing sites you want to look designed

tools.name: Replit
tools.description: Cloud IDE with AI assistance. Build, run, and deploy apps from the browser.
tools.bestFor: Building and hosting in one place

tools.name: Webflow
tools.description: Visual site builder with real CMS and hosting. Steeper learning curve, more control.
tools.bestFor: Content sites you will keep editing

tools.name: Bubble
tools.description: The most capable no-code platform, and the most complex. Real apps, real learning curve.
tools.bestFor: Marketplaces and internal tools with real logic

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.description: The default AI pair programmer. Cheapest way into AI-assisted coding if you already use VS Code.
tools.bestFor: Developers who want autocomplete, not an agent
